scope: Current-source visual vertices and named poses, separate idle/motion perspective projections, exact production fit-state contracts, plus an explicitly frozen historical-pose camera regression. No browser rendering or physical simulation.
limitations: Named poses do not cover arbitrary manually requested joint configurations or full continuous physical trajectories.
Task-space boxes conservatively cover the existing table-local task objects; they are not robot visual measurements.
Label rectangles use explicit conservative pixel estimates, not browser font metrics; final native desktop/mobile inspection remains necessary.

The 15 percent gate applies only to identical frozen historical standby poses under the two camera/layout implementations. Current standby magnifications are separate observations, not a claim that every viewport exceeds 15 percent.

Both camera comparisons use source-mesh geometry measured with the same joint pose on each side; neither compares the new shorter C5 pose with the historical straight C5 pose or with user-photo pixels.
Independent physical worlds do not calculate cross-station collision; geometric separation is not hardware safety certification.

r1CrouchWaistYaw.scope: Source visual meshes at explicitly sampled CROUCH+SPREAD waist poses only. Not a continuous whole-joint envelope, collision test or safety proof.

r1StandbyToSpread.interpolation: Linear joint interpolation at fixed 1/40 path fractions, covering the same geometric path as smoothstep timing.
r1StandbyToSpread.scope: Explicit preparation-entry samples only; this does not prove all planned returns, arbitrary joint paths or collision safety.

historical.scope: Frozen b271a9a standby geometry and motion guards on both sides: 2.2m/previous fit versus 1.6m/corner-fit with that historical motion envelope. Historical regression, not the new default idle view or current wider waist-yaw guard.

current.scope: Same current standby geometry on both sides: 2.2m/previous fit versus 1.6m/motion-envelope fit; factual observations only. Both 49-case current idle/motion projection sets remain gated above.

idleVersusPriorMotionPolicy.scope: Camera-only counterfactual: identical current standby source geometry, source-camera attachments, 1.6m offsets, lens settings and HUD margins on both sides; frozen b271a9a always-motion guards versus new actual-idle fit. Newly widened motion guards are not used to inflate this gain. This does not compare different robot poses or reproduce historical browser pixels.
